usage: Use 耳機 for headphones or earphones you wear over or in your ears. It is a very common everyday noun.
It often appears with verbs like 戴、用、插、買. For example, you can say you wear, use, plug in, or buy 耳機.
In Hong Kong Cantonese, 耳機 can refer to both over-ear headphones and in-ear earphones depending on context.
For a clearer distinction, people may say 無線耳機 for wireless headphones or 耳塞式耳機 for earbuds.
